PART I SCREWED COUPLINGS TYPE B

1. Scope — Covers the requirements for screwed type couplings. 

2. Materials — Any suitable material consistent with vacuum use such as steel, aluminium alloy, 
brassj (extruded ). 

3. Dimensions — According to Table 1. 

3.1 The threads shall conform to IS : 4218 ( Part I ) - 1976 ' ISO Metric screw threads: Part ! Basic 
and design profiles ( first revision ) ' to IS : 421 8 ( Part VI ) - 1 978 ' ISO Metric screw threads: Part VI 
Limits of sizes for commercial bolts and nuts ( diameter range 1 to 52 mm ) ( first revision ) '. 

4. Vacuum 'O' Rings — Conforming to IS : 6838-1973 " Dimensions for '0' rings and grooves for 
vacuum flanges". 

5. Tolerances 

5.1 Tolerance on External Threads — Tolerance class 6 e [see IS : 4218 ( Part IV )- 1976 ISO metric 
screw threads: Part IV Tolerancing system ]. 

5.2 Tolerance on Internal Threads — Tolerance class 6 H [ see IS : 4218 ( Part IV )] - 1976. 

5.3 Tolerance for Untoleranced Dimensions — Medium class in accordance with IS: 2102-1969 
' Allowable deviations for dimensions without specified tolerances ( first revision ) '. 

6. Designation — A coupling of nominal size 6 conforming to this standard, shall be designated as: 

Coupling 6 IS : 9705 ( Part I ) 

7. Marking— Manufacturer's name or trade-mark, size, year of manufacture. 

7.1 ISJ Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

There is already one standard on screwed type quick release couplings IS : 8262 ( Part I ) - 
1976 'Quick-release couplings for vacuum pipe lines: Part I Screwed type' based on ISO/DIS 2861. 

The coupling suggested in ISO/DIS 2861 should be adopted in the long run in our Indian 
Standard. As this changeover from the existing design may take a considerable amount of time, the 
specification on screwed type of coupling has been brought out in two parts. 



Adopted 30 December 1980
